## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or gap this feature addresses.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you'd like to see. Include any sketches, wireframes, or API designs if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context

Links to related issues, prior art, or any other context.
